output.population: Patients (n = 41) meeting DSM-5 criteria for OCD, aged 18-50 years, with or without pharmacological treatment at the time of scanning
output.summary: Structural T1-weighted MRI, resting-state fMRI, and diffusion tensor imaging from adult patients meeting DSM-5 criteria for obsessive-compulsive disorder, with or without pharmacological treatment, acquired on a 3.0 T scanner with a 32-channel head coil.
